design: Predeclared supplementary parameter sensitivity; all six final-epoch refits reported. No replacement or test-based selection of main baselines. Same frozen memberships and pinned models as main study. Not an exact replication of source split/preprocessing/framework.

other_execution_settings.checkpoint: final epoch; no new hyperparameter search
other_execution_settings.framework: PyTorch for both models; source Table IV reports tf for RoBERTa

scheduling: Wait until core study succeeds and releases its master lock; six training jobs before six supplementary evaluation jobs; no concurrent CUDA jobs.
uncertainty: 10000 paired frozen-group bootstrap draws, common to original and supplementary encoder predictions; seed sample SD separately. Legacy views weighted per unique normalized input as in core analysis.
